intent: A farm-girl harvest-festival gown of apple-red bodice and skirt stepping out in four widening tiers to a pale linen flounce, with a widening green pocketed apron, fitted linen sleeves and a tall wheat-banded kerchief, reading as a light-crowned bell from the high camera.
requests: A straw or wicker material for the basket and wheat ears; Fabric and Leather are the closest the palette allows.
An apple-red cloth colour in Kit.colors, between oxblood and rust, so farmland gowns can share one tone.
